intro: One plate of nasi goreng USA is about 800 kcal. Most calories come from the oily fried rice, the floured prawns, squid and chicken, and the thick sweet sauce.

breakdown.part: Floured fried chicken, squid and prawns
Sweet sour sauce or thick sauce

variants.name: Nasi goreng USA without flour (stir-fried toppings)

diet: Yes, but it's one of the highest-calorie choices at a tomyam shop. The fried rice already has oil, then you add floured fried toppings and sauce. If you want it, have it once in a while and keep your other meals lighter. If you crave it every week, better to pick the version without flour coating.
tips: Ask for the USA toppings to be stir-fried or cooked without flour if the shop can do it.
Ask for less rice and add mixed vegetables on the side.
Share one plate with a friend and add a vegetable soup or clear tomyam.

swap.name: White rice + clear tomyam campur + small telur dadar
swap.why: Clear tomyam gives you protein from prawns, squid and chicken without flour and thick sauce, so calories drop a lot.

faq.q: What does USA in nasi goreng USA mean?
faq.a: USA stands for Udang, Sotong, Ayam (prawn, squid, chicken). All three are usually coated in flour, fried, then tossed in sauce.

faq.q: Where can I find nasi goreng USA?
faq.a: Easiest to find at tomyam shops or Thai-style eateries in Malaysia, especially at night.

faq.q: Can I ask for less spicy or less sweet?
faq.a: Yes. Most cooks are fine with less sweet, less oil or less spicy requests. Just tell them when you order.
